subject: Re: 🔵{Brand} & MobUpps
body:
Hi RECIPIENT_NAME,
Last note from me on the pay-per-validated-apply program for {Brand}, after my earlier email on cost-per-sale and the benchmark context I shared. If validated apply quality and incrementality are on your roadmap this quarter, I can send the occupation-level validated-apply view and a short holdout read this week. If the timing is not right, I will leave it here and step back. Either way, you have the context for when it is useful.
register_notes: Stage 3 EN jobs_recruitment CPS: references original email and earlier stages (cost-per-sale, benchmark context); direct close with easy out (release the prospect if timing is wrong); no figure, no illustrative flag; 0 question marks; soft CTA; no sign-off; positives stated directly, no X-not-Y; native US-English register.
